provenance.method: paired sign-flip permutation on task-mean differences (both seeds of a task stay together), 20000 permutations, seed 20261026
provenance.immutability_note: These three historical Monte Carlo estimates are immutable source data for every later regeneration of sensitivity.json. They must NEVER be sourced from the generated sensitivity.json itself (which gets overwritten and would otherwise lose them on the second regeneration).
